properties.name: Raiders' Road Forest Drive / Stroan Loch approach
properties.reason: Forestry and Land Scotland describes a long narrow forest road with a tight turn into the car park and says the site is not suitable for caravans or large motorhomes. Useful warning for campervans despite no height barrier.
properties.evidence: Forestry and Land Scotland official visitor guidance

properties.name: Lower Cheviot forest access
properties.reason: Official guidance says the forest road has a steep entrance, is narrow with passing places and rough in places; Lower Cheviot is not suitable for large vehicles or caravans.
properties.evidence: Forestry and Land Scotland official visitor guidance

properties.name: Upper Cheviot forest access
properties.reason: Single-track forest access with passing places. Official guidance allows motorhomes but the road character merits care and checking current forestry closures.
properties.evidence: Forestry and Land Scotland official visitor guidance

properties.name: Wauchope Forest access from B6357
properties.reason: Narrow access road with passing places; Forestry and Land Scotland says the site is not suitable for caravans or large motorhomes. Transporter-sized campers should still proceed cautiously.
properties.evidence: Forestry and Land Scotland official visitor guidance

properties.name: Low Wray campsite approach
properties.reason: National Trust says the road leading to Low Wray is narrow in places and larger motorhomes should take care. A useful warning where mapping can make the approach appear routine.

properties.name: Highertown Farm / Lansallos approach
properties.reason: National Trust imposes a 6 m maximum vehicle length because of narrow lanes to the campsite. A 5.304 m LWB reference camper is within the limit but the access constraint is worth highlighting.

properties.name: Llanborth / Newborough campervan access
properties.reason: National Trust states the campervan site cannot accept larger vehicles or caravans because of restricted access. The pitches accommodate vehicles in an 8 m space, so this is caution rather than an automatic exclusion for a Transporter-sized camper.
